description: AboutIncorporated in 1995, BCPL Railway Infrastructure Ltd  executes Railway Electrification Projects, turnkey OHE projects and other projects for Railway and government parties[1]Key PointsBusiness Overview:[1][2]BCPLRIL), based in West Bengal, is a contractor for the Indian Railways specializing in overhead equipment (OHE) contracting. Its operations cover the complete cycle of designing, drawing, supply, erection, and commissioning of 25KV, 50Hz single‑phase traction overhead equipment, supporting railway infrastructure development and modernization projects.The company provides turnkey solutionsfor setting up traction substations thatregulate electrical current for energizing locomotives. In addition, it offers modification services for existing electrified tracks, enabling them to support Indian Railways’ high‑speed expansion plans.Read MoreWebsiteBSENSE
